method: Read current adapter, minimal probe source and saved native evidence; recompute saved JSON counts and SHA256. This audit does not start the VM, connect to RPC or rerun historical acceptance.
scope: Platform readiness and research observability, independent of policy strength

integration_failure_correction.contains: SSH ed25519 public host-key cache, not a private key
integration_failure_correction.cause: An unquoted space in the early OpenSSH UserKnownHostsFile option truncated the intended project cache path; not a user data location
integration_failure_correction.verification: Actual read-only project Python check confirmed100bytes, the recorded SHA256, an ssh-ed25519 public host-key line and historical outside path absent on2026-10-18. The final SSH configuration uses a project-relative ASCII known_hosts option and strict host-key checking.

audit_target: Existing phase2 backend, original conservative actor and immutable phase2 evidence before the new platform_next console integration. New console tests and research plugin coverage are reported separately in platform_next session/validation artifacts.

audit_verification.meaning: An actual project-local Python command reread every hashed input, recalculated formal row quality/feedback counts, frame-state kind occurrences and model outcomes, and asserted all six checks. This is an audit of existing evidence, not a new native run.

conclusion.meaning_of_all_information: Research oracle may inspect every field currently returned by cr-minimal.v4 and all locally recorded requests/receipts. This is not every internal engine field and is not the information available to a fair player.

locked_version.time_origin: Local first playable capture usually tick90; source time endpoint and click/deploy semantics are reconstruction hypotheses, not independently established official timing.
locked_version.source_full_initial_hand_order: unknown; bounded reconstruction from source actions, not recovered official seed

both_players.elixir: exact native fixed point; 10000 units = 1 elixir
both_players.cycle: current native cycle card IDs; private oracle information
both_players.runtime_validity_caveat: Minimal does not emit the controller/evolution runtime validity flags; an empty array does not by itself distinguish absent controller from unavailable runtime information. Numeric button meaning and exact ability identity are not fully exposed.

current_research_oracle.entity_kind_caveat: Minimal kind is a coarse structural classification: nonprojectile with HP and card_id==-1 is building; other HP objects are called troop. Root card ID can be shared by spawned child objects; neither field is a complete unit archetype identity.
current_research_oracle.cooldown_precision: Out-of-range values become null; valid remaining cooldown/deployment values are rounded up to 50ms in the probe.
current_research_oracle.scheduler_feedback: Separate adapter journal retains requested card/position/tick, registration and injection receipts, consumption confirmation, actual tick or unknown.
current_research_oracle.capacity_boundary: Minimal capture explicitly rejects object count above256, unreadable identity/pointer, bad event cursor or generation. A rejected capture is a failure, not an empty battlefield.

current_conservative_actor.reason: Explicit conservative whitelist; it currently provides less battlefield information than a human player. Research oracle and fair actor are separate contracts.
current_conservative_actor.affordability_mask: Only current own hand and own budget; excludes placement, native command readiness and abilities. Strict learning adds a separately evidenced WAIT/Fireball/Arrows subspace.

missing_or_unproven.capability: Per-attack, per-hit and damage attribution stream
missing_or_unproven.status: not exposed by active minimal profile
missing_or_unproven.reason: Only native CardPlay consumption hook is installed by minimal_capture. HP/target/cooldown snapshots do not prove which attack caused each HP change.

missing_or_unproven.capability: Full projectile physics and area effects
missing_or_unproven.reason: Objects have ID/owner/card/position/coarse kind, but minimal does not provide full source, target trajectory, velocity, configured damage/radius/remaining lifetime/status-effect semantics.

missing_or_unproven.capability: Generic ability consumption and effect confirmation
missing_or_unproven.status: injection available; generic successful consumption unconfirmed
missing_or_unproven.reason: Controller snapshots and scheduler succeeded receipt are not a unique skill-consumption event. Formal failures are retained.

missing_or_unproven.capability: Every unit/form identity and player visibility
missing_or_unproven.reason: Minimal card root may be0 or shared by child units; invisible/underground/special visibility is not attested for the current actor. Research oracle may show private entities only when explicitly labeled.

missing_or_unproven.capability: All-card placement legality and complete agent action space
missing_or_unproven.reason: Current strict policy action proof is WAIT plus ordinary Fireball/Arrows. Low-level native card scheduling is broader but not a universal legal placement oracle.

missing_or_unproven.capability: Exact replay initialization and all source actions
missing_or_unproven.reason: Source build/date/seed/full initial order are missing; four mixed-level formal episodes were rejected, nine initial-deal calibrations cycled, and abilities/unconfirmed plays remain.
Formal100 has zero independently acquired official temporal references. Same-engine determinism and rendering consistency cannot prove official full interaction equivalence.

missing_or_unproven.capability: Complete snapshot/fork and parallel isolated instances
missing_or_unproven.reason: Recovery is reset plus journal replay. Current VM/RPC must have a single owner; batch flags do not create isolated native engines.

formal100_evidence.caveat: Counts summarize the frozen historical queue with its recorded backend hash. They are not rewritten as new dashboard results; failure tags overlap and are not causal diagnoses of official divergence.

saved_render_evidence_recomputed.caveat: Occurrences are repeated snapshots, not unique entity/event counts. Capture interval exceeds one tick in parts, so transient events can be missed.

saved_agent_evidence.caveat: Restricted two-spell model, explicit spell-first fixture and inference prior; this proves saved native execution, not full card interaction coverage or intelligence.

next_platform_acceptance: Single entry starts a local dashboard without VM for archive mode.
Research oracle displays every current raw field with units/schema and unknown/null preserved.
Actor view remains visibly separate; oracle usage by any experimental policy is explicit.
Replay mode starts the pinned native runtime, displays actual same-game framebuffer, current raw state, source input and execution feedback.
Agent mode displays a newly running model battle, exact model observation/prediction, native request/consumption and terminal result.
Pause, continue, exact-step, stop and runtime ownership have working controls and saved evidence.
Missing combat/ability telemetry and official temporal references remain explicit open work; no UI label may turn unknown into confirmed.
